test_pass_names_with_index: test read_csv with index_col and names parameters to set custom index and column names
test_multi_index_no_level_names: test read_csv with multi-column index_col and header=None to parse headerless CSV data
test_multi_index_blank_df: test read_csv with MultiIndex columns and header parameter on empty or minimal CSV data
test_read_duplicate_index_explicit: test read_csv with index_col=0 to preserve duplicate index values in the resulting DataFrame
